description.value: New Town Bakery is a family-run Chinese and Filipino bakery and restaurant operating since 1980, with roots in Vancouver's historic Chinatown. The Surrey branch is one of two currently operating locations, known for award-winning apple tarts and world-famous steamed buns (Siopao) in both BBQ pork and chicken varieties. The business has been recognized by CNN Travel as a must-visit Chinatown restaurant and has received multiple Chinese Restaurant Critic's Choice awards.
